rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=200, val_chunk=5, train_n=400, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, tv_K=10, tv_step_init=0.001, tv_lambda_init=0.001, tv_share_steps=True, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-6 (breast_ct). SHARED-STEP probe (parametrisation family). iters 1-5: step (1e-2/1e-4/1e-3), depth (K=50), loss (l1) ALL collapse the K independent step[k]->~0 -> recon = FBP init, hr0. NAMED failure: with K INDEPENDENT step/lambda scalars the optimiser can zero out every step to sit on the MSE-optimal FBP fixed point. HYPOTHESIS: tv_share_steps=true collapses the 20 scalars to 2 (ONE step + ONE lambda shared across all K=10 iters). A single shared step cannot be selectively zeroed per-iter; to reduce the supervised loss AT ALL via TV it must commit to one non-zero step that does denoising across all 10 iters -- which may find a net-beneficial smoothing the per-iter version escaped. ONE KNOB: tv_share_steps false->true (step_init=1e-3, lambda_init=1e-3, K=10, mse -- all reverted to the iter-3 base to isolate the sharing knob). FALSIFIER: if the single shared step ALSO -> 0 and hr stays 0, the FBP fixed point is a parametrisation-agnostic MSE attractor -> confirms the structural ceiling (findings 2026-05-23). BUDGET: K=10 mse ~750s like iter-3, <1200s wall.
